name: Processor D (Network Impairment & MTU Fragmentation Profile)
description: Evaluates PQC wire bloat trade-offs under standard Ethernet MTU (1500 B) packet fragmentation and 15ms latency jitter via kernel netem.

network_configuration.emulation_tool: tc qdisc replace dev veth_cli root netem delay 15ms 3ms
network_configuration.fragmentation_hypothesis: Classical ECDH/ECDSA fits in a single 1500B MTU frame. ML-KEM-768 PK (1,184B) + ML-DSA-65 sig (3,309B) forces TCP segmentation (TCP MSS 1460B) across MTU boundaries and multi-segment TCP reassembly, compounding latency with network jitter.
